description: At least seven people were injured on Saturday after a man drove a car onto a crowded sidewalk in the northern Italian city of Modena on Saturday, according to a local prosecutor. author: CNN
description:
Sen. Bill Cassidy, a Louisiana Republican, has lost his bid for a third term in a remarkable defeat, after two primary challengers — including one backed by President Donald Trump — finished ahead of him in Saturday’s primary and headed to a runoff for his seat. 

Rep. Julia Letlow, who won Trump’s endorsement, and a second opponent, Louisiana State Treasurer John Fleming, will advance to the June 27 runoff, CNN’s Decision Desk projects. 

CNN’s Manu Raju discusses the result with his Inside politics panel of political reporters. Also, CNN’s Dana Bash examines the trend of Congressional Republicans losing their seats after opposing Trump.

0:00 Sen. Bill Cassidy speaks out after losing the Louisiana primary election 
1:37 Trump posts social media message celebrating Cassidy’s loss 
4:55 Will Cassidy be a thorn in Trump administration’s side until he leaves office next year? 
7:21 Former Trump aide Sean Spicer reacts to Cassidy being defeated 

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5R
title: GOP senator targeted by Trump loses seat. Hear his response

author: CNN
description:
Republicans appear to have come out on top of a national fight over congressional maps, in what could be a major boon to their efforts to protect their narrow majority ahead of the midterm elections in November. In recent weeks, the Supreme Court’s decision to gut a significant part of the Voting Rights Act led to new efforts in several Republican states and a decision from Virginia’s highest court blocked a new Democratic-friendly plan voters had approved.

The developments mark a major shift in Republicans’ favor in the battle that President Donald Trump and his party launched last year. It had previously appeared headed towards a virtual draw, with Democratic states all but canceling out Republican redraws.

0:00 Tom Foreman at the magic wall to explain the redistricting showdown
4:15 Redistricting update: South Carolina and Tennessee
9:07 Maggie Haberman on redistricting ramifications
10:23 Jeffries leading redistricting push to boost Democrats: Johnson calls it 'arson'
17:36 SCOT
title: America's redistricting showdown: The map so far | Redistricting roundup

author: CNN
description: Tens of thousands gathered in London for a "Unite the Kingdom" rally organized by far-right, anti-Muslim activist Tommy Robinson. The Metropolitan Police said it had launched a “significant” policing operation, amid fears that the protest could clash with a pro-Palestinian Nakba Day march elsewhere in the city. The police said it had made 11 arrests for a variety of offenses. CNN's Jomana Karadsheh reports. #cnn #news
title: Thousands descend on London for far-right rally
